description: Find contract opportunities (bids) by keyword, NAICS, PSC, set-aside, agency, state, notice type, posted dates or deadline. To have new and changed notices pushed instead of polling, any key can open the WebSocket change stream at wss://stream.samgovapi.io/v1/stream (Free: 5 minutes late; paid plans: real time). Costs credits like the REST call. Every answer has meta.as_of (the dataset date) and a record_url to the SAM.gov or USAspending source.

agency_code.description: Department or sub-tier code from the agencies list.

deadline_to.description: Response deadline on or before, YYYY-MM-DD.

open.description: true for open bids: deadline not passed, award notices left out.

set_aside.description: Set-aside code, such as SBA, 8A, WOSB, SDVOSBC.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: search_opportunities
